title: Let a holder cite a whole, same-item non-holder record (for example a coordinator audit) as attributed criterion evidence in termal_evaluate_acceptance
outcome: Let a holder cite a whole, same-item non-holder record (for example a coordinator audit) as attributed criterion evidence in termal_evaluate_acceptance
acceptance: A decision recorded by both coordinators (TermAl and Engram) on whether non-holder records may be cited. If yes: the evaluator brief shows each cited non-holder record whole, with its author marked as non-holder and its family; holder-only records keep their current citability; and a test shows the evaluator can tell holder and non-holder evidence apart.
If no: the decision and its reason are recorded, and the remedy (quote the record in a holder note) is named by the refusal through w-e16e68f70aad.
